# Third-party licences

reachgraph is distributed as a single statically linked binary, and the emitted artifact
carries vendored JavaScript. Both are redistributions of other people's code, so both
notices travel here.

**This file is generated. Do not edit it.** Regenerate with
`cargo xtask third-party-licenses`; CI fails if the regenerated file differs from the
committed one.

reachgraph's own licence is MIT OR Apache-2.0 — see `LICENSE-MIT` and `LICENSE-APACHE`.

- **ISC License** — 2 crates
- **zlib License** — 2 crates

## JavaScript bundled into the binary and written into every artifact

`reachgraph-render-html` compiles these in with `include_str!` and writes them to
`out/vendor/` byte for byte. Emitting them is distribution, so the notice travels twice:
here, and in the artifact's own `vendor/LICENSES.txt`. No minification or
banner-stripping pass runs over them — for `cytoscape.min.js` the `/*! … */` banner **is**
the notice.

`cargo-about` cannot see these: they are not crates, and ADR-0001 names that residual.
They are generated here from `reachgraph-render-html/vendor/VENDOR.toml`.

| bundle | version | SPDX | obtained from |
| ------ | ------- | ---- | ------------- |
| cytoscape | 3.34.2 | MIT | https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/cytoscape/3.34.2/cytoscape.min.js |
| layout-base | 2.0.1 | MIT | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/layout-base@2.0.1/layout-base.js |
| cose-base | 2.2.0 | MIT | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/cose-base@2.2.0/cose-base.js |
| cytoscape-fcose | 2.2.0 | MIT | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/cytoscape-fcose@2.2.0/cytoscape-fcose.js |
| cytoscape-expand-collapse | 4.1.1 | MIT | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/cytoscape-expand-collapse@4.1.1/cytoscape-expand-collapse.js |
